pretty self explanatory lmao

now ur farm can be covered in wildflowers!!

there's also a vibrant version if you want brighter flowers or i made it cause i thought it would fit better with the default colours of the game (i'm using a mod that recolours the grass and dirt 

pick the file you want (if you want vibrant make sure you rename it to just 'grass.xnb') and place it in Content\TerrainFeatures overwriting the original file
you can only choose one!!!!

Credit to Eemie for the paler grass which I used <3

[b]UPDATE:[/b]

i wasnt entirely satisfied with the autumn version of the flower grass so i've created an alternate version with yellow grass and sunflowers! available in 'normal' and 'vibrant' just like the previous version :>
